title: ♫ Music City Gem 1: 1BR+1BA+W&D+5 to Broadway!
description:
Beautiful & modern space close to everything! Located in Historic East Nashville only ~5 min/2 miles to downtown! You’ll have a private bath & private bedroom in a safe, quiet neighborhood with free street parking. You’ll also have access to the kitchen, living room & laundry room, these are shared spaces with others staying in the home. The owner lives in the home, so it feels more like a boutique hotel vs a house to yourself. 

Come see all Nashville has to offer!

The space
Please read entire listing before booking, especially the ***notes at the bottom!

Perfect for a couple, two friends or a solo traveler; this comfortable space includes a private bedroom with a QUEEN size bed and your own private bathroom. Fast Fiber internet, and a desk for working if needed. You'll have key-less entrance, free street parking, and a lovely porch for coffee or wine.

Guest access
YOUR BEDROOM
Your room has a new QUEEN sized mattress, pillows, fresh linens, fluffy comforter, night stands, desk, chair and a large closet. Enjoy Netflix on your own 32” smart TV. Rest assured you’re completely safe, my home is equipped with: smoke-detector, carbon monoxide detector, fire extinguisher, flashlight, and a first-aid kit.

YOUR BATHROOM
The sparkling guest bath has a tub/shower and comes with towels, shampoo, conditioner, soap, blow dryer, and bath robes.

COMMON AREAS
The common areas (living room, kitchen, laundry) are shared with the owner and other guests. Kitchen includes fridge, stove, microwave, tea kettle, air fryer and coffee maker.  I have an additional guest room upstairs, so please be aware there may be other guests in the home. The additional guest room/bath and master room/bath are off limits.

During your stay
This is my home, so the common spaces are shared. If I'm away, my housekeeper is close by to assist with any requests. I keep to myself unless you need me.

Other things to note
I want your stay in Nashville to be the best experience possible. 

I live in the home, so it feels more like a boutique hotel vs a house to yourself. My home is 2200 sq ft, so there's plenty of room!  I’m generally on site if you need anything but I keep to myself. I’ve been hosting with Airbnb for 7 years, happy to answer any questions. There’s a Welcome Binder that has tons of details for you too!

****I have an additional guest room upstairs available separately. 

***No shoes in the house

***Keep the doors to your room and bathroom closed at all times

***Keep exterior doors closed and locked at all times

***Your cleaning fee covers only your rented space, not common spaces you use, ie. Kitchen. You are required to clean and leave them in the same state to avoid an additional cleaning fee.

***There’s 1 outdoor and 1 doorbell camera which record audio and video to keep my property safe.

***I have an indoor cat who stays in the master bedroom upstairs. They're NOT ALLOWED in the guest rooms, so guests don't have allergy issues. Keep your doors closed at ALL times. When arriving/leaving, keep exterior doors closed to keep my furry family member safe inside.

***Early check-in/late check-out is $10 per hour & must be arranged before reservation starts
